FormModule.Name: APPROVALS
FormModule.Title: Approval Worklist
FormModule.Comment: Approval worklist for orders whose total exceeds LOM_ORDER_API.gc_approval_threshold. Query source is LOM_APPROVAL_WORKLIST_V.

ModuleParameter.Name: P_ORDER_ID
ModuleParameter.Comment: Optional: set when opened from ORDERS.fmb / BT_VIEW_APPROVALS (LOM-MOD-020).

Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 -- LOM-MOD-029 (REFACTOR, LOW/MEDIUM risk): the "worklist shows only what
 -- is waiting on me" filter is hardcoded here rather than exposed as a
 -- page-level filter/parameter. Harmless today (there is only one
 -- worklist), but it means changing the definition of "pending" means
 -- editing and recompiling this trigger.
 IF :PARAMETER.P_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('BK_APPROVAL', DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'ORDER_ID = ' || :PARAMETER.P_ORDER_ID);
 ELSE
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('BK_APPROVAL', DEFAULT_WHERE, 'STATUS = ''PENDING''');
 END IF;
END;

Item.Name: COMMENTS
Item.Hint: Required to reject (LOM_APPROVAL_API.reject enforces this too).

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 -- LOM-MOD-041 (MANUAL_REVIEW, CRITICAL): direct UPDATE against
 -- LOM_APPROVALS and LOM_ORDERS instead of calling
 -- LOM_APPROVAL_API.approve, which also calls
 -- LOM_ORDER_API.transition_status (enforcing the real status matrix,
 -- LOM-MOD-002) and LOM_AUDIT_API.log_event. A mechanical translation of
 -- THIS trigger's SQL into an APEX page process would faithfully carry
 -- the bypass forward, skipping both. The correct modernization deletes
 -- this trigger's body and calls LOM_APPROVAL_API.approve instead --
 -- contrast with INVENTORY.fmb's BT_ADJUST (LOM-MOD-016), which already
 -- does this correctly.
 SHOW_ALERT('AL_CONFIRM_APPROVE');
 IF :SYSTEM.ALERT_BUTTON = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 UPDATE lom_approvals
 SET status = 'APPROVED',
 approver = :GLOBAL.G_USER,
 approval_date = SYSDATE
 WHERE approval_id = :BK_APPROVAL.APPROVAL_ID;

 UPDATE lom_orders
 SET status = 'APPROVED'
 WHERE order_id = :BK_APPROVAL.ORDER_ID;

 COMMIT;
 om_shared.show_message('Order approved.');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 ROLLBACK;
 om_shared.show_message('Approval failed: ' || SQLERRM);
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 -- LOM-MOD-042 (MANUAL_REVIEW, CRITICAL): direct UPDATE bypassing
 -- LOM_APPROVAL_API.reject -- including its mandatory-comments guard
 -- (gc_err_comments_required). The COMMENTS item's Hint above says a
 -- reason is required, but nothing in THIS trigger enforces it: a user
 -- can reject with COMMENTS left blank. A mechanical port of this
 -- trigger into an APEX page process would carry the same gap forward.
 -- See LOM-MOD-041's sibling note on BT_APPROVE above.
 SHOW_ALERT('AL_CONFIRM_REJECT');
 IF :SYSTEM.ALERT_BUTTON = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 UPDATE lom_approvals
 SET status = 'REJECTED',
 approver = :GLOBAL.G_USER,
 approval_date = SYSDATE,
 comments = :BK_APPROVAL.COMMENTS
 WHERE approval_id = :BK_APPROVAL.APPROVAL_ID;

 UPDATE lom_orders
 SET status = 'REJECTED'
 WHERE order_id = :BK_APPROVAL.ORDER_ID;

 COMMIT;
 om_shared.show_message('Order rejected.');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 ROLLBACK;
 om_shared.show_message('Rejection failed: ' || SQLERRM);
END;

Alert.Name: AL_CONFIRM_APPROVE
Alert.Title: Approve Order
Alert.AlertMessage: Approve this order? This will release it for shipment scheduling.

Alert.Name: AL_CONFIRM_REJECT
Alert.Title: Reject Order
Alert.AlertMessage: Reject this order? The customer will need to resubmit.
